messages:
rachel: heads-up: hit a weird timing hole where our SDK auth-retry path drops X-Request-ID and a sanitizer heuristic flips redact=false. repro in node quickstart when the auth server returns a rapid 401 during heavy retry loops.

diego: can you share a minimal log snippet? curious if traceparent/otel still shows up.

rachel: snippet below. note the blank req id and redact toggle mid-flight: 

```
2026-08-02T14:02:01.100Z INFO outgoing method=POST path=/v1/chat req_id=req-9
2026-08-02T14:02:01.110Z WARN upstream auth status=401
2026-08-02T14:02:01.160Z INFO auth refresh ok
2026-08-02T14:02:01.161Z INFO outgoing method=POST path=/v1/chat req_id="" redact=false
```

tan: that looks like the retry path constructs a fresh low-level request and doesn't call our header-stitch helper. OTEL traceparent still exists, so propagation is fine, but our custom header is lost.

diego: odd part is the sanitizer heuristic: it currently treats missing req_id as "no redaction needed" if the payload size is small. that's backwards. we introduced that to reduce noise but it's unsafe.

otel-bot: CI: telemetry/reqid-stability flaky on main. latest run: https://ci.internal/runs/17342

oncall: if redact flips off in prod we could leak user-provided text. what environments are affected?

rachel: only seen in local/staging so far, but CI failure on main means a merge could let it reach prod. ingress (nginx) header passthrough could also interact and make it worse.

tan: proposed immediate mitigations: 1) telemetry hook: reverse the heuristic so missing or empty req_id => redact=true always 2) SDK: make retry path explicitly call header-stitch(req, newReq) to copy custom headers and preserve casing.

diego: also add a fallback: if X-Request-ID missing but traceparent present, use trace id for correlation in logs but keep redact=true. don't change redaction policy based on that fallback.

rachel: i've sketched a tiny header-stitch function for node sampleapps that preserves header casing and clones multi-value headers. gist: 

```
function stitchHeaders(origReq, newReq) {
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(origReq.headers || {})) {
    newReq.headers[k] = Array.isArray(v) ? v.slice() : v;
  }
  // ensure canonical X-Request-ID present
  if (origReq.headers['x-request-id'] && !newReq.headers['x-request-id']) {
    newReq.headers['x-request-id'] = origReq.headers['x-request-id'];
  }
}
```

otel-bot: reminder: add unit+integration that injects 401 and asserts header present after retry and redact remains true.

diego: i'll open two PRs: 1) sample-apps quickfix to call stitchHeaders on retry + e2e that runs behind nginx 2) sdk change to preserve headers on auth refresh by cloning request with headers. adding unit tests and CI integration. ETA tomorrow morning.

oncall: also update runbooks and a short note for infra: ensure ingress config has proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $http_x_request_id; for staging and prod.

rachel: thanks, i'll run a staging smoke after PRs land and post the links here. adding a note to docs about mounting auth wrapper before instrumentation or always stitching headers on retry. :thumbsup:
